actions.action: Lift the inner nursery pot and check for standing water, soggy or sour-smelling soil
Check whether the browned tips are touching or near the cold window
Finger-test the soil and water thoroughly when the top 2–3 cm is dry
Empty leftover water from the cachepot 15 minutes after watering
Use filtered, distilled or rainwater for watering
Flush the pot with a large volume of water every 2–3 months
Move the plant so fronds are off the window glass and away from heaters or vents
Raise humidity to 40–50% with a humidifier
Alternatively group plants together to raise humidity
Trim brown tips with clean scissors following the leaf shape

reason: Dry air is named only as one of several co-causes alongside watering and tap-water salts, and raising humidity appears as one suggestion among many rather than the main fix, though nothing advised is harmful.
